purpose: Off-recipe training and held-out data for the bracket surrogate: model-written-style CadQuery variants of the template (plate and rib thickness, rib leg, width, flange depth, plate height), sandboxed, measured by CalculiX (fine mesh) on the workbench host. Plate-height margin above the upper M3 bores starts at 41.5 (below about 41 the bores break the plate edge: not a buildable bracket, and FEA cannot place the load).
